mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.counselor_id as counselorId ,a.student_id as studentId ,a.favorite_type as favoriteType ,a.favorited_at as favoritedAt ,a.created_at as createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
-- 级联表的字段 ,student.name as studentName ,student.phone as studentPhone ,student.id_card_no as studentIdCardNo ,student.avatar_url as studentAvatarUrl ,student.email as studentEmail ,counselor.name as counselorName ,counselor.phone as counselorPhone ,counselor.avatar_url as counselorAvatarUrl ,counselor.email as counselorEmail ,counselor.expertise as counselorExpertise ,counselor.resume as counselorResume ,counselor.introduction as counselorIntroduction
FROM counselor_favorite a left JOIN student student ON a.student_id = student.id left JOIN counselor counselor ON a.counselor_id = counselor.id
and a.id in
#{item}
and ( a.counselor_id = #{params.counselorId} )
and ( a.student_id = #{params.studentId} )
and a.favorite_type = #{params.favoriteType}
and UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.favorited_at) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{params.favoritedAtStart})
and UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.favorited_at) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{params.favoritedAtEnd})
and a.student_id IS NOT NULL
and student.name like CONCAT('%',#{params.studentName},'%')
and student.phone like CONCAT('%',#{params.studentPhone},'%')
and student.id_card_no like CONCAT('%',#{params.studentIdCardNo},'%')
and student.email like CONCAT('%',#{params.studentEmail},'%')
and a.counselor_id IS NOT NULL
and counselor.name like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorName},'%')
and counselor.phone like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorPhone},'%')
and counselor.email like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorEmail},'%')
and counselor.expertise like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorExpertise},'%')
and counselor.resume like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorResume},'%')
and counselor.introduction like CONCAT('%',#{params.counselorIntroduction},'%')
order by a.${params.orderBy} desc
